scope: Visible Hover Card pointer and caller-content behavior in the freshly extracted v10 x64 catalog
method: Computer Use @oai/sky foreground clicks and UI Automation value change, inspected through screenshots and accessibility text
limitations: The desktop input API supplied clicks, not standalone move-only pointer events. Move-only hover timing and a pointer jump without pressing are not claimed.
The caller editor was changed with UI Automation SetValue; physical text typing, full focus traversal and closed-content tab order remain unverified in this run.
Ancestor stacking, nested popup/modal integration, complete raster/shadows, live normal motion, scaling, performance and native ARM64 runtime remain open.
